blocks.text: For each account in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform), you can change your display image, authentication method, and audit logs export schedule, and manage AI capabilities.
To view or change your account settings:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click the Profile icon in the top navigation bar, and click Account Settings.
The account settings page appears.
On the account settings page, view or enter information in the following sections:
In the General Settings section:
Name: Displays the name of the tenant account that you logged in to.
Account Type: Displays the account type.
Account Logo: Upload a logo for the account. The supported file formats are JPG, GIF, and PNG.
Email Domain: Enter your organization's email domain.
Allow Admins to view private dashboards and reports: Select the checkbox to allow all admins in the account to view private dashboards.
Allow viewers to change dashboard level filters by default: Select the checkbox to allow all viewers to modify dashboard filters on the Edit Dashboards page.
If selected, viewers can apply filters to analyze dashboard data, but they cannot save the filters.
In the Authenticate section:
Email Domain: Displays the domain you entered in the General Settings section.
Authentication Type: Select the authentication method to authenticate users accessing this tenant.
SAML: Users can authenticate through a SAML-based identity provider (IdP). To learn more, see Generating SAML Details.
Username & Password: Users can authenticate with their username and password.
In the Audit Logs Exports section, you can schedule the automatic export of audit logs for an entity. To learn more, see Viewing Audit Logs.

In the AI Capabilities section, select Enable AI Capabilities to allow AI capabilities in the Agentic SecOps Platform. To learn more, see Managing AI Capabilities in the Agentic Security Operations Platform.
